design_philosophy.archetype: THE TERMINAL PRO (Swiss & High-Contrast meets Retro-Futurism)
design_philosophy.vibe: Authoritative, precise, reliable, elite, technical, dense.
rules: No gamified elements. Pure financial-terminal energy.
Density is key. Use high-density grids for data views, preserving optical alignment.
Zero AI-slop aesthetics (no purple gradients, no soft blurry blobs).
Colors must convey function. 95% of UI is monochrome. Accents are strictly for states, alerts, and focal points.
Hard edges or max 4px border radius. No soft, large rounded corners.
Borders are visible (1px solid). No heavy dropshadows. Use inner borders to frame content.

body.usage: Standard UI text, settings labels, tooltips

mono.usage: Data tables, financial metrics, logs, API keys, terminal outputs

layouts.spacing: Dense internally (p-3 to p-4 for cards), but with clear optical grouping.

patterns.dashboard_shell: Left sidebar (fixed, w-64, collapsed state w-16, 1px right border), top bar (h-14, sticky, 1px bottom border) containing health indicators and user menu. Main content area takes remainder.
patterns.data_tables: Compact row heights (h-8 to h-10). Mono fonts for numbers. Right-aligned numeric columns. Sticky headers.
patterns.settings_pages: Two-column layout (sidebar nav on left for tabs, scrolling content on right). Max-width container to preserve readability.

components.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)'. Container uses border-collapse style layout or 1px subtle borders on cards. No soft drop shadows.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Flat backgrounds. High contrast on hover. Small size padding (px-3 py-1.5).
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border. Background slightly darker than surface. Focus ring must be crisp (1px solid primary, no blur).
components.badges: Pill-style, very subtle background (e.g., bg-success/10 text-success).
components.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Lines should be crisp (1.5px stroke). No area gradients unless extremely subtle. Axes must use Mono font.

motion.interactions: Hover states should sharply change background or border color. No floating or scaling effects.
motion.loaders: ASCII spinners, sharp skeleton pulses, or minimalist linear progress bars.

pages_instructions.login: Center standard login box. Single user access (Owner). No 'sign up' link. Include 2FA input if triggered. Background can be a subtle dark abstract grid network.
pages_instructions.dashboard_home: High density. Top widgets for AI Core status, Active Broker status, System Load. Main area for Quick Actions and Recent Audit Logs.
pages_instructions.ai_providers: List installed models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) in a grid. Show usage bars, latency ms, health checks. Include a config modal to set API keys and default models.
pages_instructions.brokers: List of installed broker plugins. Show Connect/Disconnect toggles, health status, and primary broker radio buttons. Add account form in a side-drawer or modal.
pages_instructions.plugins: Data table of installed plugins. Columns: Name, Version, Status (Enabled/Disabled toggle), Actions (Uninstall, Settings).
pages_instructions.settings: Tabs for System, Security, Appearance (Dark/Light toggle), Notifications. Forms for updating config.
pages_instructions.user_profile: Read-only/edit forms for Owner details. Sections for active sessions (with 'Revoke' buttons) and Trusted Devices list.
pages_instructions.roles_permissions: Matrix table. Rows: Permissions, Columns: Roles (Super Admin, Admin, Developer, User). Checkboxes in cells.
pages_instructions.logs_audit: Terminal-style viewer. Mono font, black background. Search input, level filters (INFO, ERROR, WARN). Color-coded log lines (Green for INFO, Red for ERROR, Yellow for WARN).

login_background.description: Dark blue technical network grid lines and dots

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text over images must have dark overlays.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none`).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Implement a strict dark theme as default. Adjust your Tailwind config to use #0A0A0C for `background` and #121214 for `card`/`popover` backgrounds.
Use Shadcn components but strip their default borders/shadows to match the 'Terminal Pro' archetype. Set `--radius: 0.125rem;` (2px) in your css variables.
Never use generic centered layouts for data. Always left-align text, right-align numbers.
Do not add soft gradients, blur layers behind cards, or AI-slop purple UI. Keep it strict, precise, fintech-grade.
Implement real data table structures for Logs, Plugins, and Brokers. Use `JetBrains Mono` for ALL numbers, IDs, and statuses.
Use Lucide icons (already installed) or install Phosphor Icons with sharp, consistent stroke weights.
Always apply `data-testid` attributes to interactive elements to facilitate automated testing.
This is a JavaScript project (.js), so ensure all Shadcn components and logic are implemented in pure JS + React, not TypeScript (.tsx).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Create a distinctive frontend that surprises and delights.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use dark colors independently.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders sharp for this specific terminal theme.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles. For this theme: sharp edges, distinct interaction states.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, precise transitions).
Use custom scrollbars (dark, thin, no gutter).
Use Shadcn calendar for date pickers, Shadcn dropdown-menu instead of `<select>`.
